disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.who: Hm. You. You walk like you're trailing weather behind you. Who are you?
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.slain: And what have you killed? Quick now. I can smell it on you.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.reveal: Then you'll do. Hold your breath, little storm!
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.1: Pah. A wind's worth of nothing. Away with you!
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.2: Not yet. Come back when you've bled a dragon or two.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.3: Off! I've no time for the unblooded.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.cramped: Too many trees about. Find me somewhere with sky.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.who: Mm... come closer, child. The air tells me little of you. Who are you?
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.who.b: Only someone who is passing through.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.slain: And in all your wandering... what have you slain, little one? Speak slowly. I am old, and the winds are long.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.slain.b: Some of your children, I think.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.reveal: So. The winds were right about you. Then let us see what you are made of.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.1: Not yet, child. The winds have not spoken your name. Go on, go home.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.2: Hm. Young. Come back when you have seen more of the sky.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.3: Run along now. The old have no use for the green.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.busy: Ah. You again. The winds have not changed their minds.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.cramped: There is no room here for what I am. Walk with me to open ground.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.struck.1: Ha! Was that meant to sting? I've been hit harder by a breeze.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.struck.2: Again? You flail like a hatchling in a gale. Do that once more and see what happens.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.after: There. Now you know what a storm feels like. Crawl off.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.struck.1: Mm. A child tugging at my sleeve. How sweet. Run along.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.struck.2: I have watched mountains wear down to sand, little one. I can wait out your tantrum. But not for ever.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.snap: So be it. Let the old man teach you manners.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.after: Lie there and think on it. The young never listen until they're on the ground.
